title: STA 9750 Submission Material
text: I am currently pursuing an M.S. in Business Analytics at Baruch College. I work in the financial services industry, where my experience includes client service, KYC/KYB, financial data, and research. Through my coursework, I am developing my skills in Excel, Python, SQL, R, and Tableau. My career goal is to transition into a data-driven financial analyst, business analyst, or risk-related role.
